description: This file defines a registry system for plugins used in Kubernetes scheduler framework, including functions for registering, unregistering, merging plugins, and decoding configurations.

methods.name: FactoryAdapter
methods.description: Injects feature gates into a plugin factory for compatibility with older method.

methods.name: DecodeInto
methods.description: Decodes configuration data from runtime.Unknown into a specified interface, supporting JSON and YAML.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Adds a new plugin factory to the registry, error if name exists.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a plugin factory from the registry, error if not found.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges another registry into the current one.
